_readme: Affiliate / lead-gen partner configuration for the EV comparison page.
Each region lists the partners whose CTA buttons appear on every car card in that region.
TO ACTIVATE: sign up for the affiliate programme, then paste your tracking ID into 'trackingId'
and set 'enabled' to true. Buttons for disabled partners are not rendered.
rel is set to 'sponsored nofollow noopener' automatically on every affiliate link, which is
what Google requires for paid/affiliate links. Do not remove it.
Suggested programmes to apply to (you must apply yourself; each has its own approval process):
UK       - Carwow Partners, LeaseLoco, Auto Trader Affiliates, Moneyshake, Rangeful
EU       - Carwow DE, Leasingmarkt.de, Instamotion, Carvago, mobile.de partner programme
Americas - CarGurus, TrueCar Affiliate, Edmunds, Carvana, CarsDirect (via CJ/Impact networks)
Most run through affiliate networks (Awin, CJ Affiliate, Impact, Rakuten) rather than direct.
showPlaceholderCtas: when true, cars show inert 'slot' buttons wherever a live affiliate button will appear once you set trackingId + enabled. Set false to hide them entirely.
disclosureText: Volt may earn a commission when you request a quote through these links. This never affects our ratings, which are decided editorially before any partner is approached.
